backgrounds.name: The Institutionalist
backgrounds.description: You managed a psychiatric clinic where patients were treated not as suffering mortals, but as subjects and toys.
backgrounds.passiveBonus: +2 bonus on Deception and Persuasion checks when manipulating confused minds.
backgrounds.dialoguePerk: Unlocks clinical authority and bureaucratic intimidation dialogue options.

backgrounds.name: The Hollow
backgrounds.description: You were born incapable of feeling affection, guilt, or remorse. Cruelty was simply an experiment in cause and effect.
backgrounds.passiveBonus: +2 Armor Class against psychic dread and complete immunity to guilt-induced status effects.
backgrounds.dialoguePerk: Unlocks coldly rational dialogue responses that unnerve emotional apparitions.

backgrounds.name: The Rememberer
backgrounds.description: Memories of bathtubs, shaving blades, signed admissions, and muffled cries surface with crystalline, morbid clarity.
backgrounds.passiveBonus: +2 on Investigation checks when examining physical evidence and bloody inscriptions.
backgrounds.dialoguePerk: Unlocks hidden memories and instant solutions to symbolic architectural riddles.
